HIT KENYA FOUNDATION

SUPPORT THE MISSION.

Education, opportunity, community and youth programmes.

OUR PURPOSE

Small actions. Lasting possibilities.

The Foundation's focus is on bringing people together around learning, youth development and community opportunity.

Education opens doors.
WHY THE FOUNDATION MATTERS

Stronger communities begin with shared opportunity.

HIT KENYA Foundation aims to connect volunteers, coordinators, supporters and organisations around initiatives that make participation and opportunity more accessible.

Our focus is on responsible collaboration, practical community engagement and programmes that respond to real needs.

AREAS OF FOCUS

Where we aim to make a difference.

01 · EDUCATION

Learning & Access

Helping create pathways for education, knowledge-sharing and skills development.

02 · YOUTH

Skills & Opportunity

Encouraging mentorship, creativity, leadership and pathways to opportunity.

03 · COMMUNITY

People & Partnerships

Connecting communities, organisations and volunteers to work towards shared goals.

WHAT'S AHEAD

Upcoming projects & initiatives.

LIST YOUR EVENT.

Identity documents are private and used only for verification. Public organiser profiles must never expose personal phone numbers.

TICKET / SALES SETUP

Production event builder should let the organiser add Regular, VIP, Early Bird, Flash Sale, Die Hard, VVIP and Book a Table ticket types, with sale start/end dates, quantities and automatic sold-out status.
